title: Adventurous Slovakian Buckwheat Bowl
description: Peppery, crunchy date-night Slovakian dish featuring dark soft brown sugar, dashi extract, gluten-free-friendly, served in a dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Rinse the buckwheat groats until the water runs clear.
In a pot, combine the buckwheat, water, and dashi stock, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until the grains are tender.
Stir in the brown sugar, peppercorns, and red pepper flakes; cook for 2 minutes to bloom the flavors.
Transfer the mixture to a preheated dolsot, then sprinkle sesame seeds, sliced mushrooms, and chopped scallions on top.
Cover the dolsot briefly to steam the toppings, then uncover and let the bowl rest for 5 minutes to develop crunch.
Serve hot straight from the dolsot, optionally garnishing with extra sesame seeds.
